findings.finding: The tryReserveSend fast path did not retain the caller OperationContext on its flow-control permit. After a peer SETTINGS shrink, the background writer emitted backpressure events without the caller's observation identifiers.
findings.resolution: When the caller context has an event sink, associate it with the fast-path permit before transferring the buffer lease. This matches reserveSend's fallback behavior.
